description: Na₂SeO₄ is Hausmannite-derived structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Fddd space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to six equivalent O²⁻ atoms to form distorted NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with four equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids, corners with four equivalent SeO₄ tetrahedra, edges with four equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one SeO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.54 Å. Se⁶⁺ is bonded to four equivalent O²⁻ atoms to form SeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with eight equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ pentagonal pyramids. All Se-O bond lengths are 1.66 Å. O²⁻ is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and one Se⁶⁺ atom.
